html:
1What a Foundry agent is

A single agent is "a model paired with instructions and tools that can reason over a request and take action". Foundry Agent Service is "a managed platform for building, deploying and scaling AI agents".

Part Meaning
Model The deployed model that reasons
Instructions The system prompt: the agent's role and behavior
Tools What the agent can use to find information or act

Kinds of agent:

Kind Meaning
Prompt agent Declaratively defined: you give model, instructions and tools; no hosting code
Voice-based prompt agent A prompt agent for spoken conversations
Hosted agent Your own code running in a container, managed by Foundry

Exam tip

. The exam's agent is the prompt agent: model + instructions + tools. Compare with a plain chat call: the agent adds tools and a managed conversation.

2Tools an agent can use

Tool What it gives the agent
File search Find answers in files you upload
Azure AI Search Search an index of your content
Web search (and grounding with Bing) Fresh information from the web
Code interpreter Write and run code, such as calculations or charts
Function calling Call your own functions; your app runs them (client-side)
OpenAPI Call a REST API described by an OpenAPI file
MCP (Model Context Protocol) Connect to tools exposed by an MCP server
Agent-to-agent (A2A) Work with another agent

Tools are of two kinds: knowledge tools (find information: file search, web search, AI Search) and action tools (do something: code, functions, APIs). [Verify live] for the current list, because names change.

Exam tip

. "Answer from my uploaded documents" → file search. "Do calculations or draw a chart" → code interpreter. "Use today's web information" → web search. "Call my company's own function" → function calling.

3Create and test an agent in the portal

  1. Open your project in the portal.
  2. In Build, choose Agents in the left pane.
  3. Select Create agent and give it a name, for example MyAgent.
  4. Add instructions, for example "You are a helpful writing assistant".
  5. Choose the model deployment and add tools if needed.
  6. Chat with the agent in the agents playground.
  7. Ask a follow-up question to check that the agent keeps the conversation history.

4Call the agent from a client application

A lightweight client creates the agent (or uses an existing one), starts a conversation, and sends messages. This is the short program from the Microsoft quickstart.

from azure.identity import DefaultAzureCredential
from azure.ai.projects import AIProjectClient
from azure.ai.projects.models import PromptAgentDefinition

project = AIProjectClient(endpoint=FOUNDRY_PROJECT_ENDPOINT, credential=DefaultAzureCredential())

project.agents.create_version(
    agent_name=FOUNDRY_AGENT_NAME,
    definition=PromptAgentDefinition(
        model="gpt-5-mini",
        instructions="You are a helpful assistant that answers general questions",
    ),
)

openai = project.get_openai_client(agent_name=FOUNDRY_AGENT_NAME)
conversation = openai.conversations.create()

response = openai.responses.create(
    conversation=conversation.id,
    input="What is the size of France in square miles?",
)
print(response.output_text)
Line Meaning
project.agents.create_version(...) Creates the agent, or a new version if it already exists
PromptAgentDefinition(model=..., instructions=...) The definition: which model and which instructions
project.get_openai_client(agent_name=...) A client bound to that agent
openai.conversations.create() Starts a conversation that keeps the history
openai.responses.create(conversation=..., input=...) Sends a message in that conversation
a second responses.create with the same conversation id A follow-up question that knows the earlier answers
Exam tip

. The conversation id is what gives multi-turn memory to the agent. Without it, each request would be independent. Agent name picks the agent; model is the deployment it uses.

5Exam Q&A

5.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1Fabrikam Outdoors wants an assistant that answers questions from a set of uploaded product manuals. Which agent tool fits?

  • AFile search
  • BCode interpreter
  • CSpeech synthesis
  • DImage generation
Show the answer

Answer: A. File search lets the agent find answers in files you upload.

S2Which three parts define a prompt agent?

  • ARegion, subscription, resource group
  • BModel, instructions, tools
  • CToken, context, embedding
  • DTags, locks, policies
Show the answer

Answer: B. A prompt agent combines a model, instructions and tools.

S3In the client program, what makes the agent remember the earlier question in a follow-up?

  • AA higher temperature setting
  • BA different project endpoint
  • CA larger image in the prompt
  • DUsing the same conversation id
Show the answer

Answer: D. Messages sent in the same conversation keep the history.

S4A developer runs create_version for an agent name that already exists. What happens?

  • AA new version of that agent is created
  • BThe call always fails
  • CThe project is deleted
  • DThe model is retrained
Show the answer

Answer: A. The call creates the agent, or a new version if it already exists.

S5Where do you test an agent without writing code?

  • AAzure Cost Management in the Azure portal
  • BThe Azure DNS blade in the Azure portal
  • CThe agents playground in the Foundry portal
  • DA resource lock on the resource group
Show the answer

Answer: C. You can chat with the agent in the portal and ask follow-up questions.

S6An agent must run Python calculations and create a chart. Which tool fits?

  • AWeb search
  • BFile search
  • CCode interpreter
  • DLanguage detection
Show the answer

Answer: C. Code interpreter writes and runs code, for example for calculations and charts.

5.2 Recall questions

R1What is a single agent?

Show the answer

A model paired with instructions and tools that can reason over a request and take action.

R2Name the three kinds of Foundry agent.

Show the answer

Prompt agents, voice-based prompt agents and hosted agents.

R3Which tool runs code?

Show the answer

Code interpreter.

R4Which call creates an agent or a new version?

Show the answer

project.agents.create_version.

R5What keeps the history of a multi-turn chat with an agent?

Show the answer

The conversation.

R6Which area of the portal holds agents?

Show the answer

Build, then Agents.

6Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Agent model + instructions + tools; Foundry Agent Service manages it
Kinds prompt (declarative), voice-based prompt, hosted (your code in a container)
Tools file search, AI Search, web search, code interpreter, function calling, OpenAPI, MCP, A2A
Portal Build, Agents, Create agent, name, instructions, model, tools, chat, follow-up
Client create_version(PromptAgentDefinition), get_openai_client(agent_name), conversations.create(), responses.create(conversation=...)
